description: This file defines the QiblaActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying and updating the Qibla direction using a compass sensor and visual indicator.

classes.name: QiblaActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages the display and update of Qibla direction based on device sensors and user preferences.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves user preferences, calculates the Qibla bearing, and sets up the compass UI and sensor callbacks.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts the compass sensor manager to begin receiving azimuth updates.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops the compass sensor manager to conserve resources when the activity is not in the foreground.
